sources.label: AllThings.How - Clean The Library Shelf Sections and Book Sorting Guide

meta.notes: Sixteen themed shelf sections across two floors. Each section has a floor + letter code (1A, 2B, etc.) and a book theme; books matching that theme are shelved there. Section codes group by floor. Example book titles are drawn from the source to show the kind of book that belongs on each shelf. Per-section in-game screenshots are not reliably available without in-game capture, so the catalog launches image-light.

items.name: Studio
items.exampleBooks: Why Some Parts Float When Nobody is Watching, Anchored Vs Unanchored
items.cardSummary: Section 1A on the first floor holds Studio books about building experiences in Roblox Studio.

items.exampleBooks: Pet Simulator Economics for Beginners, The Psychology of Clicking Faster
